texts.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
texts.en:
An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of similar stations that at some point would have allowed for near-instantaneous travel between different parts of the galaxy.

Assuming this is a Gateway, its current state of disrepair has rendered it unusable. If it could be restored into working order, its owner would potentially be able to access any other functional gateways in the galaxy, enabling travel across huge distances in a matter of days.

texts.zh: 我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在[gateway_system.GetName]星系中。和之前的传送门不同，这个传送门并没有被人为改动过且与网络中的其他传送门连接正常。但由于破损严重，此传送门暂时无法使用。
texts.en: We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time in the [gateway_system.GetName] system. Unlike the previous one, this Gateway has not been altered in any obvious way and our scans indicate that it is still connected to the rest of the network. However, it is currently inoperable due to its poor condition.

texts.zh:
我们在[gateway_system.GetName]星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为L-星团。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型纳米机器人建造的。

虽然星门散发着微弱的能量特征，但它被故意锁定在某种维护循环中，以防止其被激活。除非我们能设法解除这一过程，不然我们将无法抵达L-星团。
texts.en:
We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near [gateway_system.GetName]. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-instantaneous travel from one part of the galaxy to another.

At some point after its initial construction its connection to the rest of the network was severed. It now offers only one valid destination - an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that our astronomers have designated the L-Cluster. Even more intriguing, the Gateway was built entirely by microscopic Nanites of an unknown design.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.

texts.zh:
我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在[gateway_system.GetName]星系附近。此传送门是由我们从没见过的微型纳米机器人所建。

和之前的传送门不同，此传送门被人进行过大幅度的改动并和传送门网络断开了连接——现在该传送门只能通往一处位于我们星系之外的陌生星域，我们的天文学家将该星域称之为L-星团。

虽然此传送门有微弱的能源信号，但它被某种维护机制锁住了，因此无法启动。除非我们能设法停止维护机制，否则无法前往L-星团。
texts.en:
We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time near [gateway_system.GetName]. It appears to have been built entirely by microscopic Nanites of an unknown design.

Unlike the previous structure, this Gateway has been significantly altered since its initial construction. Its connection to the rest of the network has been severed - instead, the only valid destination is an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that has been designated the L-Cluster by our astronomers.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.
